evidence: King Tubby is the credited mixer/engineer on 'King Tubbys Meets Rockers Uptown' (1976), built from Pablo's own rhythms and melodica takes.

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Pablo's melodica is the constant; what changes across his catalogue is how much of everything else Tubby lets vanish around it. On the 1976 record, whole bars drop to just melodica, echo, and a bass note.

explanation.age7: A dub engineer named King Tubby took an instrumental song by Augustus Pablo and remixed it into something even emptier and stranger.
explanation.age13: Pablo wrote and played the melodica parts. Tubby remixed them, dropping instruments in and out and adding huge echo, the same technique he used on vocal records, applied here to an instrumental.
explanation.adult: A rare case in the dub catalogue of the technique being applied to instrumental material from the start, rather than a vocal cut being dubbed after the fact. It shows Tubby's mixing approach as a general method, not a vocal-specific trick.
